outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Stevens County precinct results, November 4, 2014 general (58 precincts). 'LIBRARY DISTRICT - 001 Stevens County Rural Library District Proposition No. 1 ... Levy Lift For Library Services' appears in 49 precincts: every precinct except COLVILLE 1-7 and KETTLE FALLS 1-2, so the Cities of Colville and Kettle Falls are outside the district's electorate (consistent with WA DOR LIB2025, layer 12).
